Figure 8 : FID, KID, and CLIP-FID vs. CLIP-Score computed on 30K samples from COCO2014 for different SD2 models trained on smaller subsets of LAION (10M, 90M, using either original captions or synthetic BLIP2 captions. Interestingly, increasing the amount of training data from 10M to 90M samples does not lead to improved quantitative metrics across guidance scales 1 to 8. Lower FID is better; higher CLIP score is better.
